decisions.decision: ANR plan for Mulpus Brook Acres Realty Trust, 300 Holman Street, accepted for review.
Subdivision waivers granted, with a directive on shallow piping cover (#10) and a directive that insulation is required above pipe where 4 ft of cover is not provided (#19).
Waiver #17 (Section 5.6.1.3) not granted: granite curbing will be required for Oak Avenue; research still needed for Massachusetts Avenue.
Directive that insulation will be required above the pipe at any location where 4 ft of cover is not provided.
decisions.quote: note a directive that insulation will be required above the pipe

decisions.decision: Directive that if possible, any piping with shallow cover areas (<2-ft) should be lowered to increase cover.
decisions.quote: note a directive that if possible, any piping with shallow cover areas (<2-ft) should be lowered to increase cover.
